mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appuser ( APP_USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, MBTI_TYPE_ID, CREATED_AT, UFILE, MOBILE, NICKNAME, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID ) VALUES ( #{appUserId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{mbtiTypeId}, #{createAt}, #{ufile}, #{mobile}, #{nickname}, #{provider}, #{providerId})
mapper.select: SELECT u.email, u.password, a.auth FROM appuser u LEFT JOIN authorities a ON u.app_user_id = a.app_user_id WHERE u.email = #{email}
select count(*) from appuser where email=#{email}
mapper.update: update appuser set password=#{password}, mbti_type_id=#{mbtiTypeId}, ufile=#{ufile}, nickname=#{nickname}, mobile=#{mobile}, provider=#{provider}, provider_id=#{providerId} where app_user_id=1
